own_solution.law: W = Qh (1 - Tc/Th) for a reversible engine
assumptions: Qh = 800 kJ per cycle, also after any warming of the hot reservoir

defect_reasons.invalid_parameter_domain: TC060 warms a kettle of water by 150 K (and the listed variant 250 K), which for liquid water at ordinary pressure would pass boiling; the D classification is unaffected but the scenario is physically odd.
defect_reasons.other: T82B8's 'then' leaves the timing of the reservoir warming relative to the cycle mildly ambiguous (wiring assumes before the cycles), and the kettle sentences are labelled with quantity 'a temperature rise of the hot reservoir', a metadata mislabel.

notes: Verified: 800*(1-300/600) = 400; Th=670: 800*370/670 = 441.79; Th=750: 480.0; Th=850: 800*550/850 = 517.65 kJ, matching. Ideal-gas Carnot cancellation of n is correct. Minimal pairs TC060/T82B8 and TD300/T9558 share 150 K and differ only in attachment. Agrees with pass 1; I upgrade the kettle concern to medium invalid_parameter_domain on seeing the 250 K value.
